name: bazel
description: Google's scalable build system for large codebases with distributed builds and advanced caching

bazel.description: Extensible build system supporting multiple languages with hermetic builds, remote execution, and incremental compilation
bazel.usage:
bazel build //... # Build all targets
bazel test //... # Run all tests
bazel run //main:hello # Run specific target
bazel query 'deps(//main:hello)' # Query dependencies
bazel clean --expunge # Clean all build artifacts
